step1_analysis.circuit_type: Ratioed Latch with Pseudo-PMOS Clock Buffer
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a high-speed ratioed latch used as a sub-block in a dual-modulus prescaler. It utilizes pseudo-PMOS inverters to locally buffer the clock signal, which then drives the PMOS pull-up of the latch, while the NMOS pull-down is driven by the data input, forming a fast, low-area ratioed logic structure.

paper_reference.title: Dual-Modulus 127/128 FOM Enhanced Prescaler Design in 0.35-m CMOS Technology

delay_data_eval.description: Propagation delay from Data rising to Output falling during the transparent phase (CLK=0).

sky130_expected.calculation: In ratioed logic, the NMOS discharges the node against the PMOS pull-up. Delay ~ C_load * VDD / (I_nmos - I_pmos). With SKY130 at 1.8V, I_nmos is significantly larger than I_pmos for equal sizing. Expect ~50-150ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 at 1.8V has higher drive strength and lower parasitic capacitance than the original 0.35um 3V process, leading to faster evaluation.

delay_clk_precharge.description: Propagation delay from CLK falling to Output rising (pull-up phase).

sky130_expected.calculation: The PMOS pulls up the output node when the NMOS is off. Delay ~ C_load * VDD / I_pmos. Expect ~50-250ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS mobility is lower than NMOS, making the pull-up phase slower than the pull-down evaluation phase, consistent with the paper's reported asymmetry.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the latch sub-block at 1GHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power (C*V^2*f) + Static power from pseudo-PMOS and ratioed states. Static current per pseudo-PMOS gate ~ 100-200uA. Total expected power for this sub-block ~ 500uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Pseudo-PMOS and ratioed logic consume significant static power when evaluating to logic 0, which dominates the power consumption compared to standard CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the evaluation delay, precharge delay, and average power consumption of the ratioed latch at 1GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Ratioed Latch with Pseudo-PMOS Clock Buffer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N1 N3 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN4 N4 0 1.8
VN0 N0 0 0

* Bias for pseudo-PMOS (always ON)
Vbias1 LABEL_NET_0 0 0
Vbias2 LABEL_NET_3 0 0

* CLK: 1GHz, 50% duty cycle
VCLK LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 10p 10p 490p 1n)
* Data: 1GHz, shifted to test transparent and hold phases
VDATA LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.2n 10p 10p 0.49n 1n)

* Initial conditions to ensure clean first transitions
.ic v(N1)=0 v(N2)=1.8 v(N3)=0

.control
tran 1p 4n

* Measure delay from Data rising to N1 falling (transparent phase)
meas tran delay_data_eval trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure delay from CLK falling to N1 rising (precharge phase)
meas tran delay_clk_precharge trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=2

* Measure average currents to calculate power
meas tran avg_i_vdd avg i(VVDD)
meas tran avg_i_n4 avg i(VN4)

* Print results
print delay_data_eval
print delay_clk_precharge
print avg_i_vdd
print avg_i_n4

quit
.endc
